verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that prompts can be tested interactively in a dedicated LLM Playground, and that prompts can be iterated in the UI and checked via experiments against datasets. However, the evidence is only a single-line mention of the playground. It gives no detail on which real model providers are supported or on substituting variables into prompt templates. Missing for 10: documented support for selecting and calling real models in the playground, documentation of variable/template substitution, in-depth playground docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
